audit_exempt_reason: Decorative surface border — WCAG 1.4.11 (Non-Text Contrast) exempts borders that do not convey state or meaning. Borders that convey focus, selection, or error state have their own dedicated pairs and are NOT exempt.
notes: Decorative border — intentionally subtle. WCAG 1.4.11 (Non-Text Contrast) only requires 3:1 for borders that convey meaning (focus, selected, error). Default surface borders are exempt. If this border is being used to convey state, a higher-contrast variant should be chosen.
